study_role: Posthoc exploratory extension; previously exposed geographic and temporal evaluation sets; no new blind validation
unchanged: All raw inputs, labels, fits, feature lists, seeds, original policies and original acceptances retained. No new prediction model fitting.
primary: Geographic and temporal fixed calibrated champion routes; 9to27 preop and 27to38 paired analyzed separately; cannot chain different cohorts/model families as patient benefit.

uncertainty.unit: patient group within evaluation context; paired resampling for comparisons; centers are described individually, not randomized hospital samples
uncertainty.type: percentile 95% intervals conditional on fixed fits/rules; does not correct selection optimism
uncertainty.random_comparator: one predeclared SHA256 patient-priority seed20261108, plus 200-seed randomization distribution separately from patient CI
uncertainty.daily: observed calendar spans incl zeros and active operation days separately; 7day block bootstrap for mean/p95; no invented shift clocks

rules: existing 25% selective capacity and individual rules, 50% sensitivity
base-risk nearest existing development training_capacity20 threshold25%
Q1.primary_budget: review capacity20% plus upgrade25% at collection/review cost ratio0.1; exact integer realized budget. Cost ratio0,.05,.1,.25 sensitivity; base expansion and full collection review capacity consume same budget. Data-field completion only, not diagnostic-test recommendation.
Q1.outputs: paired event captures/losses, capture transitions, missing fields vs already recorded fields, 9/27/38 record alignment and availability audit

Q2.candidate_rule: reuse development-locked gate at25%, nearest frozen development threshold25%, highest-risk25%; evaluate all without target winner selection
Q2.thresholds: unchanged development training_sensitivity80 and training_capacity20 for final review; fixed training_capacity20 primary; top20% retrospective capacity supportive
Q2.comparators: no update/all update/random/existing selective and cost sensitivity
Q2.deployability: no claim of real-time readiness absent feature-release/end-of-operation clocks

Q3.estimand: surgery-date-indexed potential demand under fixed per-person thresholds; actual operation dates are not actual alert arrival dates
Q3.daily: per center and calendar day incl zeros; unique patient groups, potential repeated stage reviews, upgrade requests, total requests; capacities5/10/20 per day; estimate quantiles/overload; action completion unobserved
Q3.costs: separate review minutes5/10/15, chart field completion0.25/1 minute per missing nonlab field, new sample/result0/5/10 minutes per missing lab; personnel substitution remains scenario only

Q4.metrics: per line/cohort/stage/center fixed-route n/events, prevalence, Brier, O/E, offset intercept, slope and AUROC when identified; review fraction/capture at frozen training thresholds with CIs
Q4.adaptation: no local recalibration reused as external validity; audit LOCO inputs and prior evaluation exposure; no outcome-driven center exclusion

Q5.audit: original Chinese date/SCr window source; INSPIRE surgery start/end/lab first-criterion evidence and known release-time gap; MIMIC exact chart/store times and procedure-date limitation
Q5.supportive_MIMIC: exact decimal 0.3mg/dL absolute rise from previous48h and 1.5x previous7day measured SCr at day1..7; separate current frozen59 calendar-ratio events; no relabel/refit; report clock availability, baseline interval and discharge truncation
Q5.leadtime: only true model-availability timestamp to criterion if all required clocks available; otherwise reuse recorded landmark interval with explicit label; do not infer KDIGO urine component

Q6.sources: audit registry meanings and INSPIRE death/RRT/discharge source; hard-outcome associations using frozen risk scores, not optimized labels
Q6.eligible_analysis: fixed risk per doubling (logit units if score saturates), AUROC/Brier for binary hard outcomes with event counts; LOS Spearman and medians, in-hospital death separated; descriptive low/high fixed training threshold contrasts with patient bootstrap
Q6.causal: implementation treatment/action/time-zero/confounding/positivity absent => no implementation causal effect; no fabricated IV/RRR

Q7.low_risk: p below frozen development training_sensitivity80; training_capacity20 sensitivity; report event rate/capture misses with Wilson and patient bootstrap
Q7.observation: MIMIC per day1..7 SCr availability counts; delete alternate-calendar-day measurements and first-per-day/first48h sensitivity using retained source ratio endpoint; report lost observed events, measured testing savings and detection lag; unknown events never imputed zero
Q7.bounds: missed known events lower bound; event rate among unmonitored unknown; no stopping-safety claim

additional_review.MIMIC_Brier: verify current759/59 and existing target-rate null comparator; apparent null vs fixed source constant distinguished
additional_review.bands: verify existing original-grid max-deviation band semantics and source matches; no finite-sample exact guarantee
additional_review.optimism: audit nested procedure-selected predictions vs fixed-route outer CV; no full selection bootstrap fabricated; no massive full refits without estimand benefit

resources.environment: reuse registered clinical-stats Python if dependency probe passes, or registered AKI legacy runtime for compatibility
resources.GPU: small fixed-score summaries/optimization and resampling CPU NumPy; GPU transfer/precision change not justified; no model fitting
resources.OS_headroom: at least max(4GiB,25% actual available); finite processes exit

implementation: Scientific integration/statistical estimands require Codex-led implementation; no unrelated local-model residency reload. Independent scalar/alternative numeric implementation required, no human independent-review claim.
